pages.text: $(bold)Description:$() The Throne is in the void around the End's main island, a considerable distance from it.$(br2)The exact bearing and distance are determined by the current iteration's seed and differ from iteration to iteration.$(br2)Coordinates found in the previous iteration are invalid for this one.
$(bold)Approach procedure:$() The distance is enough to kill you. Travel only once you have stable supplies and a means of flight.$(br2)The method of arrival is unrestricted.

$(bold)Navigation:$() Holding a $(bold)completed OBSR-3$() and right-clicking empty space in the End generates a particle beam pointing at the Throne, and gives the remaining distance.$(br2)This navigation can be used any number of times.
